name: Agent and Non-Human Identity
blurb: The explosion of machine identities: agent credentials, delegated authority, revocation, and the lateral movement paths nobody is watching.

items.name: OWASP: Agentic AI threats and mitigations
items.note: The reference threat model for autonomous agents: identity, delegation, memory, and tool-use risks with mitigations.

items.name: Zero trust architecture
items.note: NIST SP 800-207 is the architectural baseline the industry extends to non-human identities: never trust, always verify, applied to agent credentials.
